title: Go Lang: Comments Are Not Directives
guide_zh: Go 开始借注释表达指令，作者担忧这会给语言长期设计带来问题。
author: Merkur
excerpt: Go 1.4 starts to use comments as directives. I think that is a realy bad path to go on the long run. You see its beginnings in following 3 examples: # used to set a canonical import path for a package: //import "foo" # used to generate code: //go:generate bar # used to document the result of a example function: //Output: foo Comments should not be directives. Comments are free form, they do not have a syntax (as demonstrated in the examples). Comments are for humans - program
